text:
Maya: Heads up — noticed a sustained increase in per-token tail latency for /api/chat-stream after the last runtime rollout. p95 per-token up ~30ms vs baseline. attaching profiler snippet and quick notes.

Adrian: Which time window? whole cluster or single shard? link to grafana?

Maya: cluster-wide but concentrated on region us-west-2. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/abcd/per-token-latency?var-route=/api/chat-stream — look at token_index > 8. Snapshot from profiler attached.

Lucas: quick PromQL to sanity-check distribution:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le,kernel,batch_size) (rate(runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/api/chat-stream"}[5m])))
```
This shows kernel X has the worst tail when batch_size in [1,4] and seq_len>128.

Sasha: I also see kv cache eviction spikes around the same time yesterday. might be churn causing extra memory refs and slower KV lookups. query: `increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[1h])` spiked ~2k.

InfraBot: Noted — recent kernel-selection config change (commit 1a2b3c) enabled prefer_frag_math for seq_len>128 by default. Deploy: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/1a2b3c — rollout started ~1850000080.

Adrian: That matches. prefer_frag_math lowered throughput on small batches in our perf lab; could explain higher per-token tail for small batch sizes. Proposal: canary revert to legacy kernel for /api/chat-stream first.

Maya: Agree. Also want better telemetry on continuous-batcher heuristics: batch_size histogram + queue wait + scheduler_efficiency per route. Current panels are too coarse.

Lucas: Suggested PromQL snippets for new panels:
```promql
# batch size p50/p95 per route
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, route) (rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])))

# average queue wait (5m)
avg_over_time(queue_wait_seconds{route="/api/chat-stream"}[5m])

# scheduler efficiency (useful tokens / total tokens)
(sum(rate(useful_tokens_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(total_tokens_total[5m])) by (route)) * 100
```
These should be per-route so we can see regressions without aggregating away the signal.

Sasha: Also suggest a tiny dashboard panel that correlates kv_cache.evictions and per-token p95 with a 5-min offset — to catch eviction-induced stalls. Add an alert: p95 token latency > 50ms for >5m on any production route.

Adrian: For the canary revert: run
```
./tools/rollout set kernel_selector=legacy --route /api/chat-stream --canary 10%
```
Then watch batch_size histograms and token p95. If improves, ramp 50% then full.

DevOpsBot: Deploy bot: Canary rollout started for /api/chat-stream at 10% with kernel_selector=legacy (triggered by @Adrian). Canary job id: deploy-1850000140.

Maya: I'll watch the new panels and attach profiler dumps during canary. If kv evictions remain high we should also throttle eviction policy or bump cache size for the hot shard.

Sasha: Quick checklist for dashboard changes: add (1) batch_size histogram panel per-route, (2) token-level p50/p95 heatmap by token_index, (3) queue_wait percentile sparks, (4) scheduler_efficiency trend + daily baseline. Keep panels lightweight.

Maya: Sounds good. Thanks all — starting canary watch. +1 :thumbsup:

Adrian: I'll keep an eye and be ready to rollback if latency regresses.

InfraBot: CI note: regression test 'batching-heap-pressure' passed locally for legacy kernel, failed on prefer_frag_math in lab. Attaching logs.

Maya: Closing thread for now; will update with canary results in a follow-up message.
